services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: An extraordinary venue for your extraordinary wedding! The Villa Zorayda was originally built in 1883 as a Gilded Age home. The incredible architecture is replicated after the Alhambra Palace in Granada, Spain and makes for a unique and romantic backdrop to wedding ceremonies. History surrounds wedding celebrations held in this intimate venue in downtown St. Augustine. Please fill out our inquiry form below for information on hosting your ceremony at the Villa Zorayda Museum. The Villa Zorayda Museum is a beautiful and intimate space for Elopements in the heart of downtown St. Augustine. Rent the Museum for just the two of you or up to 10 guests for an Elopement.
